verdict.rationale: The homepage shows RFE-rate and average-days-to-submission counters, plus a Forbes AI 50 adoption badge. None of the evidence shows any approval or success rate published with case counts, a time window, or a methodology. The Forbes cohort describes customer adoption, not outcomes, so it does not count as a stated basis for a success rate.

support.subject: As a founder, any advertised approval or success rate comes with a stated basis — case counts, time window, or methodology — on the provider's own pages
